title: Bedrock — Free Bootstrap 6 Construction & Civil Engineering Template
excerpt: A free two-page Bootstrap 6 construction template — capabilities, sectors, a project grid, a Stepper-driven process section, accreditations and a tender request form.
yoastTitle: Bedrock — Free Bootstrap 6 Construction & Civil Engineering Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 construction and civil engineering website template with a tender enquiry form using Datepicker and Combobox, a Stepper process section, project case study page and animated statistics.
intro: Bedrock is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 website template for construction firms, civil engineering contractors, groundworks companies and trades operating at commercial scale. It pairs a full contractor homepage — capabilities, sectors, projects, process, accreditations and a tender enquiry — with a project case study page.
note: Contractors get judged on whether the site looks like it belongs to people who deliver, so this one is deliberately hard-edged: no rounded corners anywhere, a safety-yellow accent on dark slate, and a full-width statistics strip that counts up when it scrolls into view. The Bootstrap 6 showpiece is the Stepper used as a page section rather than inside a form — five stages from enquiry to handover — alongside a tender enquiry built on Datepicker and a multi-select Combobox. Stepper, Datepicker and Combobox have no Bootstrap 5 equivalent.
summary: Bedrock is a free, premium two-page Bootstrap 6 template for construction and civil engineering firms. The homepage runs a photographic hero with a keyline-marked copy block, a full-width statistics strip that counts up on scroll, six capability cards, a numbered sector list, a project grid, a five-stage process Stepper, audited accreditations and a tender enquiry form using Datepicker and a multi-select Combobox. The project page adds a case study with problem, scope and outcome sections plus a sticky facts rail. Hard-edged dark design with a safety-yellow accent, ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, no build step, full light and dark mode.
